name: country-road-simulator
description: Narrow lanes, high hedges, tractors and sheep: a considerate-driving game set on the country roads of England, Wales and Scotland.

scripts.stage:itch: npm run build && rm -rf release/itch && mkdir -p release/itch/dist && cp index.html style.css og-image.jpg release/itch/ && cp dist/country-road.js release/itch/dist/
scripts.publish:itch: npm test && npm run stage:itch && butler push release/itch usmanaman/country-road-simulator:html --userversion "$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)"
